description: Two-column layout: a fixed-basis sidebar beside a flexible content column that wraps below it when there is no room. nav and aside children are the sidebar; every other child is content (hr, [role=separator], template, script and style are skipped); without nav/aside the first child is the sidebar and the last the content. Attribute form: data-layout="sidebar".

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between the columns, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-side
attributes.description: end: put the sidebar on the end side. Omit the attribute for the start side (there is no start value). nav/aside children keep DOM order (order: 1); the positional fallback reverses the row (flex-direction: row-reverse), so visual order then differs from DOM order.

attributes.name: data-layout-sidebar-width
attributes.description: Sidebar basis: 12 / 16 / 20rem (the same three values in every sidebar context).

attributes.name: data-layout-content-min
attributes.description: Content column floor before wrapping: 40 / 50 / 60%. One-off: style="--layout-content-min: 45%".

attributes.name: data-layout-nowrap
attributes.description: Never wrap; the sidebar stays beside the content, also inside a narrow (< 40rem) data-page-layout main.

childAttributes.name: data-layout-sticky
childAttributes.description: Sticky sidebar with its own scroll, active when the page opts into the smart sticky system (:root[data-sticky]).
